comments.quote: The rooms were clean and tidy, the landlady was warm and attentive, the food was delicious, and the breakfast was also very good. If you're planning a trip to Moganshan Scenic Area, you might consider this guesthouse; parking is convenient.

comments.quote: The owners were very warm and hospitable, the food was delicious, the rooms were clean and hygienic, and they were very helpful in giving directions. It was a truly unforgettable trip.
